messages:
Alex Chen: SIEM alert — surge of IAM SetIamPolicy events at 03:12 UTC. ~50 bindings added for group infra-admins on project redwood-prod. Looks programmatic, paging sec oncall. snippet: protoPayload.methodName=SetIamPolicy resource=projects/redwood-prod actor:serviceAccount:deploy-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com binding: role=roles/owner members=[group:infra-admins@redwood.com]
Sam_R: On it. Can you paste the exact audit log entry id or full payload?
Alex Chen: log_entry id = projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity/1234567890123456789 proto:... methodName=SetIamPolicy resourceName=projects/redwood-prod policy.bindings[0].members=[group:infra-admins@redwood.com]
Priya Patel: Paging sec oncall. If a deploy-runner SA did this we need immediate containment. @Maria any deploys around 03:05-03:15?
Maria Gonzalez: We had a canary for auth-service at 03:08. Checking CI. deploy-bot shows job infra/iam-reconcile ran ~03:11. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4821
deploy-bot: Job #4821 started by pipeline 'infra/iam-reconcile' — triggered by PR #234.
Sam_R: infra/iam-reconcile — that job reconciles IAM templates. If it's mis-typed it could have promoted infra group to owner. I'll pause the pipeline now.
Alex Chen: Pause it and revoke the binding immediately. Suggest removing group:infra-admins from owner and applying least-priv role.
Sam_R: Pausing pipeline... 
deploy-bot: pipeline infra/iam-reconcile paused by Sam_R.
Maria Gonzalez: Running revoke now:
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member='group:infra-admins@redwood.com' \
  --role='roles/owner'
```
Maria Gonzalez: Removed owner binding. Adding stopgap viewer permission so services don't break:
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member='group:infra-admins@redwood.com' \
  --role='roles/viewer'
```
Priya Patel: Good containment. Next: rotate keys for deploy-runner SA and enumerate any actions it performed. Which SA key was used?
Sam_R: KMS/audit shows service account key (key id = abcdef12) created 2024-11-02 used by pipeline. We'll rotate and delete the old key. Commands I'm running:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/new-key.json --iam-account=deploy-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete abcdef12 --iam-account=deploy-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Alex Chen: Capture a forensic snapshot of audit logs and push to secure bucket before we rotate so we have unchanged evidence. I triggered export: S3 path s3://sec-audit-snapshots/2017894321.tar.gz
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2021 created and acknowledged by Priya Patel. Link: https://sec.redwood/inc/INC-2021
Priya Patel: Triage notes on INC-2021: probable misconfiguration in infra/iam-reconcile pipeline template causing owner grants. Containment steps executed: pipeline paused, owner binding removed, SA keys rotated. Assigning postmortem and long-term fixes.
Alex Chen: Quick checklist for handoff:
- Disabled infra/iam-reconcile pipeline
- Removed owner binding from group infra-admins, added viewer
- Rotated deploy-runner SA keys and deleted old keys
- Exported audit snapshot to s3://sec-audit-snapshots/2017894321.tar.gz
- Opened INC-2021 and PM-472 for postmortem
Priya Patel: Postmortem ticket PM-472 created, owner: Priya Patel. Action items: CI guard to block owner-level grants without two approvals; unit test for IAM templates; scheduled emergency RBAC review with infra team tomorrow 10:00 PST.
oncall-night: Copy — I'll take over at 04:00 UTC. Please add any outstanding items and current status.
Alex Chen: Status: no further SetIamPolicy events after 03:18 UTC. Logs show only the one window tied to job #4821. Forensics snapshot completed. Handing off to @oncall-night for monitoring and follow-up.
oncall-night: Acknowledged. I'll update INC-2021 with timeline and mark war-room as monitored. Last check 03:50 UTC — no recurrence. If nothing new by 05:00 UTC I'll close the active war-room and leave notes for morning.
Priya Patel: Thanks team. We'll reconvene for RCA on PM-472. If @oncall-night sees anything odd escalate to SEV channel and tag me. :white_check_mark:
